title: Calibrated Functional Prediction from Overlapping Nonlinear Observations
abstract: arXiv:2611.20567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study prediction of nonlinear audit functionals from scalar observations of a shared hidden table state. For Schur-rational operators, local Gaussian projections yield a common sparse kernel for overlapping tasks, repeated row identities, and cross-row dependence. Shared-state residual samples extend this kernel through a positive-semidefinite feature representation. Positive matrix integration and sample-value enclosures connect the original inputs to the actual saved hybrid prediction. A sorted calibration-role perturbation bound then certifies its complete finite-pool pinball risk. Independent complete-loss selection chooses the ridge, score scale, and residual weight, while task-rank calibration supplies an upper endpoint. Evaluation uses twenty new reference contexts per dataset at two task sizes, giving 400 conditions across ten benchmark populations. The mean dataset complete-loss ratios are 0.9977 to the degree-two kernel, 0.9

translated_title: 从重叠非线性观测中进行校准泛函预测
translated_abstract: 我们研究从共享隐藏表状态的标量观测中预测非线性审计泛函。对于Schur有理算子，局部高斯投影为重叠任务、重复行标识以及跨行依赖产生一个共同的稀疏核。共享状态残差样本通过半正定特征表示扩展了这一核。正矩阵积分和样本值区间将原始输入与实际保存的混合预测连接起来。随后，排序校准角色扰动界为其完整的有限池钉球风险提供了证明。独立的完全损失选择确定岭参数、分数尺度和残差权重，而任务秩校准则提供一个上端点。评估在每个数据集上使用二十个新参考上下文，涵盖两个任务规模，在十个基准总体上共给出400个条件。平均数据集完全损失比相对于二次核为0.9977……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于Schur有理算子与局部高斯投影的共享稀疏核方法，结合半正定特征表示、正矩阵积分与排序校准扰动界，实现了从重叠非线性观测出发、具有完整有限池钉球风险保证的校准泛函预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a shared sparse kernel based on Schur-rational operators and local Gaussian projections, combined with positive-semidefinite feature representations, positive matrix integration, and sorted calibration-role perturbation bounds, achieving calibrated functional prediction with certified complete finite-pool pinball risk from overlapping nonlinear observations.
